exam_scheme.note: Conducted by the BCECE Board pursuant to the Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Act, 1995 as an offline pen-and-paper OMR test across 5 subject papers (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, Agriculture). Each paper carries 100 questions of 4 marks each (400 marks, 90 minutes) with a negative marking of 1 mark for incorrect answers. Candidates appear for relevant subject combinations (PCM, PCB, PCMB, or Agriculture groups CBA/MBA/MCA/PCA) depending on chosen degree courses in Agriculture, Horticulture, B.Pharm, B.Sc. Nursing, and Allied Health Sciences.
